answer_1.quote: Recently, pre-trained language models (PLM), e.g. GPT-2 , have shown great promise in many applications of natural language generation, such as stylized text generation and dialog system ...

answer_2.quote: We use five different metrics, including human evaluation, to measure the generation performance of each method ... • PPL reflects the average density of samples ... • Rev-PPL is a good indicator ... • EMD-l is the earth mover distance between sentence lengths ... • EMD-f is the earth mover distance between word frequencies ...

answer_4.quote: We ask 4 volunteers to select a score from {0, 0.5, 1} for each sample according to their fluency and coherence with the target style.
answer_4.guideline: Volunteers rate each generated sample on fluency and coherence using a 0/0.5/1 scale.
